header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Afzal Kareem Virk advocate holding brief on behalf of
Syed Zeeshan Ali Shah advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Afzal Kareem Virk advocate, holding brief on behalf
body: of Syed Zeeshan Ali Shah advocate for the applicant, under instructions does not press instant Criminal Misc. Application and submits that trial Court may be directed to conclude the trial within a shortest possible time. Such proposal is not opposed by learned D.P.G. Consequently, instant Criminal Misc. Application is dismissed as not pressed; however, learned trial court is directed to conclude the trial of the case (arising out of F.I.R bearing Crime No. 28/2026 for offence u/s 489-F,506(ii),504 P.P.C of PS Umerkot City) within 60 days hereof.
